documents.title: Framework agreement
documents.text:
Framework agreement: Thornbury Software (fictional, authored test material).
Thornbury Software had incident response time of 23 hours in FY2023. For Thornbury Software, delay penalty cap in FY2024 was 6.7%. Total contract value at Thornbury GmbH stood at SEK 231.3m in FY2024 (reported basis). Thornbury Software had payment terms of around 54 days in FY2025. The force majeure scope for Thornbury Software is understood as follows: includes supplier labour disputes.

documents.title: Change order
documents.text:
Change order: Thornbury Software (fictional, authored test material).
Thornbury Software had warranty period of 27 months in FY2025, as originally reported. For Thornbury Software, performance bond in FY2025 was SEK 12.8m (reported basis), second issue (corrects the first issue). Delay penalty cap at Thornbury Nordic, a subsidiary stood at 8.3% in FY2024. Thornbury Oy had total contract value of SEK 294.6m in FY2024 (reported basis).

documents.title: Procurement evaluation note
documents.text:
Procurement evaluation note: Thornbury Software (fictional, authored test material).
Thornbury Software had incident response time of 29 hours in FY2025. For Thornbury Software, warranty period in FY2025 was 19 months, as restated in the latest accounts. Performance bond at Thornbury Software stood at SEK 10.6m in FY2025 (reported basis), first issue. Thornbury Software had payment terms of 55 days in FY2025. The force majeure scope for Thornbury Software is understood as follows: excludes any labour dispute.
